attributed_to: ReelSec platform design (baseline round gated by a bare environment variable), NOT a ReelShort application failure
reason: The baseline round executed destructive uninstalls of the test package on the device under the sole authority of REELSEC_ALLOW_TEST_DEVICE_UNINSTALL=1. A blanket env flag is not an authorization. The application package was removed as a side effect of a diagnostic round.

runtime.NEXT_ACTION: None. The round is recorded as a safety/design failure; no campaign is re-run until the Autonomous Evidence Platform safety gate is in force.

authorization = hash-bound, exact-match (operation/package/user/device), time-bounded document; environment variables are violations, never authorizations
nine-step chain enforced: gate -> package match -> user match -> device identity -> pre-snapshot -> authorization -> operation -> post-verification -> audit record (executed AND blocked attempts)
orchestrator.doctor blocks the entire platform while any blanket destructive flag is set: SAFETY: BLOCKED / No package was modified / No runtime campaign executed
run_baseline_runtime and the stage-10 signature-mismatch path now route every uninstall through safety_gate.execute_destructive
